note: What a codebase bundle carries besides its module: the assets of its entry, under assets/ in the bundle (ADR 0010), which a harness extracts into its working directory (ADR 0002, decision 3; D10). The push, version and replacement decisions of WR-49/c to /g have no counterpart: windmill-lite deploys nothing, and the bundle digest follows every input (ADR 0010).

cases.title: an asset is carried in the bundle at its to path
cases.rest_in: the step suite (steps/bun/wr-49.yaml): a spawned harness extracts it into its working directory, where the script reads it

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    assets: [{from: f/cb/data/a.txt, to: data/a.txt}]
folder.f/cb/asset.ts:
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
export function main() { return readFileSync("data/a.txt", "utf8"); }

cases.title: two scripts that extract the same content to one path share it

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    assets: [{from: f/cb/a.txt, to: shared.txt}]
  - relative_path: f/other
    includes: ["f/other/**"]
    assets: [{from: f/other/same.txt, to: shared.txt}]

cases.title: two scripts that extract different content to one path fail the build
cases.note: ADR 0002, decision 3, and ADR 0001 §5a: a harness process has one working directory (D10), so two assets at one path cannot both be there.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    assets: [{from: f/cb/a.txt, to: data/x.txt}]
  - relative_path: f/other
    includes: ["f/other/**"]
    assets: [{from: f/other/b.txt, to: data/x.txt}]

cases.title: an asset whose to leaves the working directory is refused

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    assets: [{from: f/cb/a.txt, to: ../escape.txt}]

cases.title: a bundle with several output files is refused
cases.note: esbuild emits a second file for a file loader or a native add-on; the CLI then uploads a tar of every output, a layout the reference covers only at medium confidence (WR-49, Q-WR-25), so the build refuses it (ADR 0001 §5a).

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    loader: {".bin": "file"}
folder.f/cb/multi.ts:
import p from "./blob.bin";
export function main() { return p; }
